title: A new API for URL rendering
body:
One of the reccuring problem with the URL sync is that the URL generated are ugly. This is because it is a solution that is meant to work in every case. It's great for prototyping but when you have a better idea of the kind of parameters you will have in your state then it's really a pain.

### Proposed API

Provide two functions:

* one that let the user transform the state into a string
* one that does the opposite (harder to code but doable if we prevent an instanciated state)
